objective: A new automatic shipment must choose a usable accessible Logistics Centre with an actual eligible on-duty idle handler instead of an earlier requested-but-unfilled centre.
scope: game/logistics/rear_logistics.gd::_advance_request new-manifest centre selection and no-candidate waiting only
game/dispatch/dispatch_service.gd narrow ready_dispatch_site plus shared exact existing _ready_worker eligibility predicate
acceptance: Requested target remains positive, actual idle handler eligible under existing Dispatch rule, accessible registered site
Skip requested-but-unfilled earlier centre; choose later usable centre; preserve current centre insertion order among multiple usable candidates
One bounded candidate read per new selection: each current rear actor inspected at most once with narrow person status; ephemeral duty facts only
No eligible candidate waits for a usable on-duty handler, without calling the whole base unstaffed or prescribing extra hires
Already accepted manifests never use the new selector and keep captured site/berth/cargo/claims/return/cancellation

ownership.staffing: Existing Rear request targets/priorities and assignment/reporting owner unchanged; no automatic worker seizure
ownership.eligibility: Dispatch owns the exact existing predicate: matching duty, no pending reassignment, Idle phase, health>0, no stock carry, no weapon carry, in the original boolean order
ownership.selection: Dispatch narrow read selects registered accessible requested site with current eligible handler. Read actor person-status once per selection, preserve site order. No reservation/assignment occurs in the query.
ownership.manifest: Existing Dispatch.accept remains physical admission owner and captures site, berth, crew, stock and return commitments. Existing request.manifest branch remains ahead of selection unchanged.

events: Existing session state_changed/simulation_changed wakes finite RearLogistics work. Selector is called once for an unbound active request after cancellation/paused guards; no new timer, subscription, per-frame polling or recurring cache.
cancellation: Accepted/cancelled/returning work keeps original captured ownership. New selector never relocates manifests or their claims/carries. Zero requested target withdraws permission for new selection even if a person temporarily remains present.

verification.policy: No local engine, regression tests/suites, broad scenarios, failure injection or full chain. Existing45s GitHub optional direct-check only.
verification.direct_plan: One newly supplied current-change script: ordinary8-worker purchase, actual construction of two Logistics Centres using approved starting M11, normal seven-hauler/one-later-handler targets leaving earlier requested1 unfilled. Query new selector once and require later site. Inspect actual existing Dispatch ready-worker identity/phase. No fake hull, supplies or natural need; no reverse/coverage matrix or old checker execution.
verification.source_only: No eligible-site waiting, configured-order preservation, shared-predicate equivalence, read-only query and accepted-manifest/cancellation invariants reviewed directly in source; direct script does not establish manifest admission, physical shipment or full loop.
verification.runtime: 45-second fixed GitHub process deadline, no automatic rerun/limit growth. Retain actual direct input/artifact hashes separately; do not equate submitted bytes with executed bytes.

unchanged: Approved opening including6000 HQ E02, prices/recipes/rates, targets/priorities, physical crew/fuel/route/safety/capacity/receiving admissions, existing eligibility and cancellation rules.
lessons: Requested count is intent, not physical presence
One usable instance suffices; an arbitrary first instance cannot establish capability
Share authoritative eligibility without adding repeated per-site full-person inspections
Preserve predicate order and captured physical ownership; source/call-count facts are not executed outcomes

sources.applies: Godot Dictionary preserves insertion order; retain existing registered-centre preference among usable sites.
Existing state-change signals and finite work remain; no new polling is needed.
